application_details.scheme_name: Nisbets, 4-10 Tower Street, London - Refurbishment Project

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: Due to the highly constrained nature of the site and the limited floor area, it is not feasible to provide separate internal or external waste storage without significantly compromising the operational functionality and retail layout of the unit. Given the unit’s small scale and its operation as a low-waste retail showroom, waste will be minimal and will be managed through daily internal collection and frequent off-site disposal by private contractor, in accordance with a waste management agreement. There is no opportunity for external bin stores due to the lack of rear or side access and public-facing frontage constraints.

decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0003-ELEV-P1-R1; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0001-GF_GA-P1-R3; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0002-BA_GA-P1-R3; Location plan; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0004-GA_EX-P1; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0005-GA_EX-P1; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0006-ELEV_EX-P1; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0007-SECTIONS_EX-P1; 0296-NI_TOWER_ST-RIL-00-XX-DR-I-0012-SECTION-P1; Noise Risk Assessment Ver. No.1 dated 23/10/2025, Noise Management Plan Version 1.3 dated October 2025.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
